+import csv
+import io
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from contextlib import redirect_stderr
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from stockroom.inventory import Inventory
+from stockroom.models import ReorderRule, StockLevel, Transfer
+from stockroom.transfers import planTransfers
+
+
+class TransfersTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_planTransfers_uses_available_stock_and_sorts_skus(self):
+        levels = [
+            StockLevel("Z", "main", 10, 5),
+            StockLevel("Z", "shop", 7),
+            StockLevel("A", "main", 0),
+            StockLevel("A", "shop", 20),
+            StockLevel("C", "main", 0),
+            StockLevel("C", "shop", 8),
+            StockLevel("D", "main", 5),
+            StockLevel("D", "shop", 5),
+            StockLevel("E", "main", 10),
+            StockLevel("IGNORED", "warehouse", 100),
+            StockLevel("NO-RULE", "main", 0),
+        ]
+        rules = {sku: ReorderRule(sku, point, 100) for sku, point in (
+            ("Z", 5), ("A", 5), ("C", 5), ("D", 5), ("E", 2),
+            ("IGNORED", 5),
+        )}
+        warnings = io.StringIO()
+        with redirect_stderr(warnings):
+            plan = planTransfers(Inventory(levels), rules)
+
+        self.assertEqual(plan, [
+            Transfer("A", "shop", "main", 6),
+            Transfer("C", "shop", "main", 2),
+            Transfer("E", "main", "shop", 3),
+            Transfer("Z", "shop", "main", 1),
+        ])
+        self.assertEqual(warnings.getvalue().splitlines(), [
+            "warning: C at main still missing 4 units",
+            "warning: D at main still missing 1 units",
+            "warning: D at shop still missing 1 units",
+        ])
+
+    def test_command_writes_csv_and_count(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            root = Path(directory)
+            levels = root / "levels.csv"
+            rules = root / "rules.csv"
+            output = root / "transfers.csv"
+            levels.write_text(
+                "sku,location,on_hand,reserved\n"
+                "B,main,0,0\nB,shop,20,0\n"
+                "A,main,10,0\nA,shop,0,0\n",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            rules.write_text(
+                "sku,reorder_point,reorder_qty\nB,5,50\nA,2,50\n",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            result = self.runCommand(levels, rules, output)
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.strip(), "2 transfers proposed")
+            with output.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+                self.assertEqual(list(csv.reader(handle)), [
+                    ["sku", "source", "destination", "quantity"],
+                    ["A", "main", "shop", "3"],
+                    ["B", "shop", "main", "6"],
+                ])
+
+    def test_command_writes_header_only_when_no_transfer(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            root = Path(directory)
+            levels = root / "levels.csv"
+            rules = root / "rules.csv"
+            output = root / "transfers.csv"
+            levels.write_text("sku,location,on_hand\nA,main,10\nA,shop,10\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            rules.write_text("sku,reorder_point,reorder_qty\nA,2,50\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            result = self.runCommand(levels, rules, output)
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.strip(), "0 transfers proposed")
+            self.assertEqual(output.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), [
+                "sku,source,destination,quantity",
+            ])
+
+    def test_missing_input_returns_two_without_creating_output(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            root = Path(directory)
+            levels = root / "levels.csv"
+            rules = root / "rules.csv"
+            output = root / "transfers.csv"
+            levels.write_text("sku,location,on_hand\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            rules.write_text("sku,reorder_point,reorder_qty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            for missing in (levels, rules):
+                with self.subTest(missing=missing.name):
+                    missing.unlink()
+                    result = self.runCommand(levels, rules, output)
+                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
+                    self.assertTrue(result.stderr.startswith("warning:"))
+                    self.assertEqual(output.exists(), False)
+                    missing.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    def runCommand(self, levels: Path, rules: Path, output: Path) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+        return subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom.transfers", str(levels), str(rules), str(output)],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=False,
+        )

@@ -0,0 +1,133 @@
+"""Classify crontab entries and write a plain text report."""
+
+import argparse
+import calendar
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from cronlint.crontab import CrontabEntry, read_crontab
+from cronlint.errors import CronError
+from cronlint.fields import DAY, HOUR, MINUTE, MONTH, WEEKDAY
+from cronlint.parser import parse_expression
+from cronlint.schedule import Schedule
+
+
+class Kind(Enum):
+    MINUTELY = "minutely"
+    HOURLY = "hourly"
+    DAILY = "daily"
+    WEEKLY = "weekly"
+    MONTHLY = "monthly"
+    YEARLY = "yearly"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Classification:
+    kind: Kind
+    interval: int | None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ClassifiedEntry:
+    entry: CrontabEntry
+    kind: Kind
+    interval: int | None
+
+
+def _has_possible_day(schedule: Schedule) -> bool:
+    """Check day-of-month values against a leap year of allowed months."""
+    return any(day <= calendar.monthrange(2024, month)[1]
+               for month in schedule.values[MONTH]
+               for day in schedule.values[DAY])
+
+
+def _cycle_interval(positions: list[int], length: int) -> int | None:
+    """Find a common gap, including the wrap to the next cycle."""
+    gaps = [right - left for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:])]
+    gaps.append(length - positions[-1] + positions[0])
+    return gaps[0] if len(set(gaps)) == 1 else None
+
+
+def classify_schedule(schedule: Schedule) -> Classification:
+    """Return a schedule's first applicable kind and its constant gap."""
+    if schedule.weekday_star and not _has_possible_day(schedule):
+        raise ValueError("schedule can never run: {}".format(schedule.expression))
+
+    if not schedule.is_full(MONTH):
+        return Classification(Kind.YEARLY, None)
+    if not schedule.is_full(DAY):
+        return Classification(Kind.MONTHLY, None)
+    if not schedule.is_full(WEEKDAY):
+        # A non-star, full day-of-month field makes every day match under
+        # cron's OR rule, even when the weekday field is restricted.
+        weekdays = (range(7) if not schedule.day_star else
+                    [day for day in range(7) if (day + 1) % 7 in schedule.values[WEEKDAY]])
+        positions = [day * 1440 + hour * 60 + minute
+                     for day in weekdays
+                     for hour, minute in schedule.times()]
+        return Classification(Kind.WEEKLY, _cycle_interval(positions, 7 * 1440))
+    if not schedule.is_full(HOUR):
+        positions = [hour * 60 + minute for hour, minute in schedule.times()]
+        return Classification(Kind.DAILY, _cycle_interval(positions, 1440))
+    if not schedule.is_full(MINUTE):
+        positions = sorted(schedule.values[MINUTE])
+        return Classification(Kind.HOURLY, _cycle_interval(positions, 60))
+    return Classification(Kind.MINUTELY, 1)
+
+
+def classify_entry(entry: CrontabEntry) -> ClassifiedEntry:
+    """Classify one entry, with its source line in any invalid-entry error."""
+    try:
+        result = classify_schedule(parse_expression(entry.expression))
+        return ClassifiedEntry(entry, result.kind, result.interval)
+    except (CronError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("line {}: {}".format(entry.line, error)) from None
+
+
+def classify_crontab(path: str) -> list[ClassifiedEntry]:
+    """Read and classify every entry in a crontab."""
+    try:
+        return [classify_entry(entry) for entry in read_crontab(path)]
+    except CronError as error:
+        raise ValueError(str(error)) from None
+
+
+def format_report(entries: list[ClassifiedEntry]) -> str:
+    """Return the complete report, including a totals line."""
+    counts = {kind: 0 for kind in Kind}
+    lines = []
+    for item in entries:
+        entry = item.entry
+        counts[item.kind] += 1
+        interval = "every {} min".format(item.interval) if item.interval is not None else "irregular"
+        lines.append("line {}: {} ({}) {}".format(entry.line, item.kind.value,
+                                                  interval, entry.command))
+    lines.append(" ".join("{}={}".format(kind.value, counts[kind]) for kind in Kind))
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def write_report(crontab_path: str, report_path: str) -> None:
+    """Validate the input before creating or changing the report."""
+    report = format_report(classify_crontab(crontab_path))
+    destination = Path(report_path)
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    destination.write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m cronlint.classify")
+    parser.add_argument("crontab_file")
+    parser.add_argument("report_file")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        write_report(args.crontab_file, args.report_file)
+    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
+        print("error: {}".format(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Classify crontab entries and write a plain text report."""
+import argparse
+import calendar
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import date, timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Optional
+
+from cronlint.crontab import CrontabEntry, read_crontab
+from cronlint.errors import CronError, CronSyntaxError
+from cronlint.fields import DAY, HOUR, MINUTE, MONTH, WEEKDAY
+from cronlint.parser import parse_expression
+from cronlint.schedule import Schedule
+
+KINDS = ("minutely", "hourly", "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ClassifiedEntry:
+    """A crontab entry with its kind and constant interval, if any."""
+
+    entry: CrontabEntry
+    kind: str
+    interval: Optional[int]
+
+
+def kind_of(schedule: Schedule) -> str:
+    """Return the first kind whose field is restricted."""
+    for field, kind in ((MONTH, "yearly"), (DAY, "monthly"),
+                        (WEEKDAY, "weekly"), (HOUR, "daily"),
+                        (MINUTE, "hourly")):
+        if not schedule.is_full(field):
+            return kind
+    return "minutely"
+
+
+def never_runs(schedule: Schedule) -> bool:
+    """Detect an impossible day of month when weekdays cannot rescue it."""
+    return schedule.weekday_star and all(
+        all(day > calendar.monthrange(2024, month)[1] for day in schedule.values[DAY])
+        for month in schedule.values[MONTH]
+    )
+
+
+def cycle_interval(offsets: list[int], cycle_minutes: int) -> Optional[int]:
+    """Return the common gap, including the gap across the cycle boundary."""
+    gaps = [right - left for left, right in zip(offsets, offsets[1:])]
+    gaps.append(cycle_minutes + offsets[0] - offsets[-1])
+    return gaps[0] if all(gap == gaps[0] for gap in gaps) else None
+
+
+def interval_of(schedule: Schedule, kind: str) -> Optional[int]:
+    """Return the fixed interval of an hourly, daily or weekly schedule."""
+    if kind == "minutely":
+        return 1
+    if kind == "hourly":
+        return cycle_interval(sorted(schedule.values[MINUTE]), 60)
+    if kind == "daily":
+        offsets = [hour * 60 + minute for hour, minute in schedule.times()]
+        return cycle_interval(offsets, 24 * 60)
+    if kind == "weekly":
+        sunday = date(2026, 1, 4)
+        times = [hour * 60 + minute for hour, minute in schedule.times()]
+        offsets = [day * 24 * 60 + minute
+                   for day in range(7)
+                   if schedule.matches_day(sunday + timedelta(days=day))
+                   for minute in times]
+        return cycle_interval(offsets, 7 * 24 * 60)
+    return None
+
+
+def classify_entry(entry: CrontabEntry) -> ClassifiedEntry:
+    """Classify one entry, raising CronError if it is invalid."""
+    try:
+        schedule = parse_expression(entry.expression)
+    except CronError as err:
+        raise CronSyntaxError(f"line {entry.line}: {err}") from None
+    if never_runs(schedule):
+        raise CronSyntaxError(f"line {entry.line}: schedule can never run")
+    kind = kind_of(schedule)
+    return ClassifiedEntry(entry, kind, interval_of(schedule, kind))
+
+
+def classify_crontab(path: str) -> list[ClassifiedEntry]:
+    """Read and classify every entry, or raise on the first invalid entry."""
+    return [classify_entry(entry) for entry in read_crontab(path)]
+
+
+def render_report(entries: list[ClassifiedEntry]) -> str:
+    """Render one line per entry followed by counts for all six kinds."""
+    totals = {kind: 0 for kind in KINDS}
+    lines = []
+    for result in entries:
+        totals[result.kind] += 1
+        interval = (f"every {result.interval} min" if result.interval is not None
+                    else "irregular")
+        lines.append(f"line {result.entry.line}: {result.kind} ({interval}) {result.entry.command}\n")
+    lines.append(" ".join(f"{kind}={totals[kind]}" for kind in KINDS) + "\n")
+    return "".join(lines)
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
+    """Write a classification report; return 2 on invalid input or file errors."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m cronlint.classify")
+    parser.add_argument("crontab_file")
+    parser.add_argument("report_file")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        report = render_report(classify_crontab(args.crontab_file))
+        path = Path(args.report_file)
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
+    except (CronError, OSError) as err:
+        print(f"error: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Remove old snapshots of one source from a backup root."""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import sys
+
+from .catalog import list_snapshots
+from .manifest import MANIFEST_NAME
+
+
+def prune_snapshots(
+    backup_root: str, name: str, keep: int
+) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]] | None, str]:
+    """Keep the newest snapshots and remove older ones with manifests.
+
+    Returns (report, "") on success and (None, reason) for invalid input.
+    Report lists contain snapshot folder names in oldest-first order.
+    """
+    if isinstance(keep, bool) or not isinstance(keep, int) or keep < 1:
+        return None, "KEEP must be a whole number of at least 1"
+    if not name or name in (".", "..") or os.sep in name or "/" in name:
+        return None, "invalid source name: {!r}".format(name)
+    source_root = os.path.join(backup_root, name)
+    if os.path.islink(source_root):
+        return None, "source folder is a symbolic link: {}".format(source_root)
+
+    folders, error = list_snapshots(backup_root, name)
+    if folders is None or not folders:
+        return None, error or "no snapshots for {!r} in {}".format(name, backup_root)
+
+    older = folders[:-keep]
+    kept = folders[-keep:]
+    report = {
+        "kept": [os.path.basename(folder) for folder in kept],
+        "removed": [],
+        "skipped": [],
+    }
+    for folder in older:
+        stamp = os.path.basename(folder)
+        if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, MANIFEST_NAME)):
+            report["skipped"].append(stamp)
+            print("warning: leaving {}: no {}".format(folder, MANIFEST_NAME), file=sys.stderr)
+            continue
+        shutil.rmtree(folder)
+        report["removed"].append(stamp)
+        print("removed {}".format(folder))
+    return report, ""
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Remove old snapshots of one source")
+    parser.add_argument("backup_root", metavar="BACKUP_ROOT")
+    parser.add_argument("name", metavar="NAME")
+    parser.add_argument("keep", metavar="KEEP", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("report", metavar="REPORT")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    report, error = prune_snapshots(args.backup_root, args.name, args.keep)
+    if report is None:
+        print("error: {}".format(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    with open(args.report, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        json.dump(report, handle, indent=2)
+        handle.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Remove old snapshots of one source from a backup root."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import shutil
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from snapback.catalog import list_snapshots
+from snapback.manifest import MANIFEST_NAME
+
+
+def prune_snapshots(backup_root: str | Path, name: str, keep: int) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Keep the newest ``keep`` snapshots and report what happened, oldest first.
+
+    A timestamped folder without a manifest is left in place. Invalid requests
+    raise ValueError before any snapshot is removed.
+    """
+    if type(keep) is not int or keep < 1:
+        raise ValueError("KEEP must be a whole number of at least 1")
+    if not name or name in (".", "..") or Path(name).name != name or "/" in name or "\\" in name:
+        raise ValueError("invalid source name: {!r}".format(name))
+    if (Path(backup_root) / name).is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("source folder is a symlink: {!r}".format(name))
+
+    folders, error = list_snapshots(str(backup_root), name)
+    if folders is None or not folders:
+        raise ValueError(error or "no snapshots for {!r} in {}".format(name, backup_root))
+
+    older = [Path(folder) for folder in folders[:-keep]]
+    kept = [Path(folder).name for folder in folders[-keep:]]
+    result = {"kept": kept, "removed": [], "skipped": []}
+    for folder in older:
+        if not (folder / MANIFEST_NAME).is_file():
+            print("warning: leaving snapshot without manifest:", folder, file=sys.stderr)
+            result["skipped"].append(folder.name)
+            continue
+        if folder.is_symlink():
+            folder.unlink()
+        else:
+            shutil.rmtree(folder)
+        print("removed snapshot:", folder)
+        result["removed"].append(folder.name)
+    return result
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prune old snapshots of one source")
+    parser.add_argument("backup_root", metavar="BACKUP_ROOT")
+    parser.add_argument("name", metavar="NAME")
+    parser.add_argument("keep", metavar="KEEP")
+    parser.add_argument("report", metavar="REPORT", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?[0-9]+", args.keep) is None:
+        print("error: KEEP must be a whole number of at least 1", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    keep = int(args.keep)
+    try:
+        result = prune_snapshots(args.backup_root, args.name, keep)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print("error:", exc, file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    args.report.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Apply a promotion to a cart and write a JSON summary from the command line."""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import io
+import json
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from cartkit.cart import Cart
+from cartkit.catalog import Catalog, load_catalog
+from cartkit.errors import CartError, UnknownProductError
+
+
+CENT = Decimal("0.01")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PromoCode:
+    """A promotion and its minimum eligible subtotal."""
+
+    code: str
+    kind: str
+    value: Decimal
+    min_spend: Decimal
+
+
+def _rows(csv_text: str, columns: list[str]) -> csv.DictReader:
+    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text))
+    if reader.fieldnames != columns:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected CSV header: {','.join(columns)}")
+    return reader
+
+
+def _amount(text: str, label: str) -> Decimal:
+    try:
+        amount = Decimal(text.strip())
+        if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0 or amount != amount.quantize(CENT):
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid {label}: {text!r}")
+        return amount.quantize(CENT)
+    except (InvalidOperation, AttributeError):
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid {label}: {text!r}") from None
+
+
+def load_order(csv_text: str, catalog: Catalog) -> Cart:
+    """Build a cart from SKU and quantity rows, merging repeated SKUs."""
+    cart = Cart(catalog)
+    for row_number, row in enumerate(_rows(csv_text, ["sku", "quantity"]), start=2):
+        try:
+            sku = row["sku"].strip()
+            quantity = int(row["quantity"])
+            cart.add(sku, quantity)
+        except UnknownProductError as exc:
+            raise KeyError(f"order row {row_number}: {exc}") from exc
+        except (AttributeError, CartError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"order row {row_number}: {exc}") from exc
+    return cart
+
+
+def load_codes(csv_text: str) -> dict[str, PromoCode]:
+    """Read promo codes indexed without regard to letter case."""
+    codes = {}
+    for row_number, row in enumerate(
+        _rows(csv_text, ["code", "kind", "value", "min_spend"]), start=2
+    ):
+        try:
+            code = row["code"].strip()
+            kind = row["kind"].strip()
+            value_text = row["value"].strip()
+            min_text = row["min_spend"].strip()
+            if not code:
+                raise ValueError("empty code")
+            if kind == "percent":
+                if not value_text.isdecimal() or not 1 <= int(value_text) <= 100:
+                    raise ValueError(f"invalid percent: {value_text!r}")
+                value = Decimal(value_text)
+            elif kind == "fixed":
+                value = _amount(value_text, "fixed value")
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid kind: {kind!r}")
+            minimum = _amount(min_text, "min_spend") if min_text else Decimal("0.00")
+            key = code.casefold()
+            if key in codes:
+                raise ValueError(f"duplicate code: {code}")
+            codes[key] = PromoCode(code, kind, value, minimum)
+        except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"codes row {row_number}: {exc}") from exc
+    return codes
+
+
+def apply_promo(cart: Cart, codes: dict[str, PromoCode], code: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return JSON-ready totals for a code applied to the cart subtotal."""
+    try:
+        promotion = codes[code.casefold()]
+    except KeyError:
+        raise KeyError(f"unknown code: {code}") from None
+    subtotal = (Decimal(cart.subtotal()) / 100).quantize(CENT)
+    if subtotal < promotion.min_spend:
+        raise ValueError(f"code {promotion.code} requires a subtotal of {promotion.min_spend:.2f}")
+    if promotion.kind == "percent":
+        discount = (subtotal * promotion.value / 100).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+    else:
+        discount = promotion.value
+    discount = min(discount, subtotal)
+    total = subtotal - discount
+    return {
+        "code": promotion.code,
+        "subtotal": f"{subtotal:.2f}",
+        "discount": f"{discount:.2f}",
+        "total": f"{total:.2f}",
+        "line": f"Promo {promotion.code}: -${discount:.2f}",
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Apply a promo from CSV files and write the JSON result to a file."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Preview a promotion for an order")
+    parser.add_argument("catalog")
+    parser.add_argument("order")
+    parser.add_argument("codes")
+    parser.add_argument("code")
+    parser.add_argument("output")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        catalog = load_catalog(Path(args.catalog).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        cart = load_order(Path(args.order).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), catalog)
+        codes = load_codes(Path(args.codes).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        result = apply_promo(cart, codes, args.code)
+        Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(result), encoding="utf-8")
+    except (CartError, OSError, KeyError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"promo: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+                value = int(value_text)
+            elif kind == "fixed":
+                value = parse_price(value_text)
+            else:
+                raise InvalidPromoCodeError("unknown kind: {}".format(kind))
+            minimum = parse_price(minimum_text) if minimum_text else 0
+            key = code.casefold()
+            if key in codes:
+                raise InvalidPromoCodeError("duplicate code: {}".format(code))
+            codes[key] = PromoCode(code, kind, value, minimum)
+        except CartError as exc:
+            raise InvalidPromoCodeError("row {}: {}".format(row_number, exc)) from None
+    return codes
+
+
+def apply_code(cart: Cart, codes: dict[str, PromoCode], code: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return the discounted cart subtotal and its receipt line."""
+    promo = codes.get(code.casefold())
+    if promo is None:
+        raise UnknownPromoCodeError("unknown promo code: {}".format(code))
+    subtotal = cart.subtotal()
+    if subtotal < promo.min_spend_cents:
+        raise PromoMinimumSpendError(
+            "promo {} requires a minimum spend of {}".format(
+                promo.code, format_price(promo.min_spend_cents)
+            )
+        )
+    discount = (
+        percent_of(subtotal, promo.value * 100)
+        if promo.kind == "percent" else promo.value
+    )
+    discount = min(discount, subtotal)
+    return {
+        "code": promo.code,
+        "subtotal": format_price(subtotal)[1:],
+        "discount": format_price(discount)[1:],
+        "total": format_price(subtotal - discount)[1:],
+        "line": "Promo {}: -{}".format(promo.code, format_price(discount)),
+    }
+
+
+def load_order(csv_text: str, cart: Cart) -> None:
+    """Add order CSV rows to a cart, merging repeated SKUs."""
+    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text))
+    if reader.fieldnames != ["sku", "quantity"]:
+        raise ValueError("order CSV needs header sku,quantity")
+    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
+        if None in row or any(value is None for value in row.values()):
+            raise ValueError("order row {}: wrong number of columns".format(row_number))
+        try:
+            quantity = int(row["quantity"])
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError("order row {}: invalid quantity".format(row_number)) from None
+        cart.add(row["sku"].strip(), quantity)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Read the CSV inputs and write the promo result as JSON."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Apply a promo code to an order")
+    parser.add_argument("catalog", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("order", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("codes", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("code")
+    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        catalog = load_catalog(args.catalog.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        cart = Cart(catalog)
+        load_order(args.order.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), cart)
+        codes = load_codes(args.codes.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        result = apply_code(cart, codes, args.code)
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    except (CartError, ValueError, OSError, csv.Error) as exc:
+        print("promo: {}".format(exc), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Build a backlinks report for a notes folder."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from notegrep.notes import load_notes
+from notegrep.parse import extract_links
+
+REPORT_FILE = "backlinks.json"
+
+
+def build_report(root: Path) -> dict:
+    """Count links and find the notes that link to each note.
+
+    :param root: the notes folder.
+    :returns: the report containing note and link counts, backlinks, and broken links.
+    :raises NotADirectoryError: if ``root`` is not a folder.
+    """
+    notes = load_notes(root)
+    targets: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+    for note in notes:
+        targets.setdefault(note.name.casefold(), set()).add(note.name)
+
+    backlinks: dict[str, set[str]] = {name: set() for names in targets.values() for name in names}
+    broken: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    link_count = 0
+    for note in notes:
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for target in extract_links(note.text):
+            key = target.casefold()
+            if key in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add(key)
+            link_count += 1
+            if key in targets:
+                for name in targets[key]:
+                    backlinks[name].add(note.name)
+            else:
+                broken.setdefault(note.name, []).append(target)
+
+    return {
+        "notes": len(notes),
+        "links": link_count,
+        "backlinks": {name: sorted(backlinks[name]) for name in sorted(backlinks)},
+        "broken": broken,
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Write a backlinks report and show broken links and totals.
+
+    :param argv: the arguments; the process arguments when ``None``.
+    :returns: the exit status; 2 when the notes folder is missing.
+    """
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notegrep.backlinks", description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path, help="the notes folder")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if not args.root.is_dir():
+        print(f"error: {args.root} is not a folder", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    report = build_report(args.root)
+    target = args.root / REPORT_FILE
+    target.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
+    for name, missing in report["broken"].items():
+        for link in missing:
+            print(f"broken link: {name}: {link}")
+    broken_count = sum(len(missing) for missing in report["broken"].values())
+    print(f"read {report['notes']} notes, {report['links']} links, {broken_count} broken links")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Write a backlinks and broken links report for a notes folder."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import logging
+import os
+from typing import Any
+
+from notegrep.notes import load_notes
+from notegrep.parse import extract_links
+
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+REPORT_FILE = "backlinks.json"
+
+
+def build_backlinks(root: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build a backlinks report from the readable notes in a folder.
+
+    Args:
+        root: Folder containing the notes.
+
+    Returns:
+        The note and link counts, backlinks, and broken targets.
+
+    Raises:
+        NotADirectoryError: If root is not a folder.
+    """
+    notes = load_notes(root)
+    by_name = {note.name.casefold(): note.name for note in notes}
+    backlinks: dict[str, set[str]] = {note.name: set() for note in notes}
+    broken: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    link_count = 0
+
+    for note in notes:
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for target in extract_links(note.text):
+            key = target.casefold()
+            if key in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add(key)
+            link_count += 1
+            destination = by_name.get(key)
+            if destination is None:
+                broken.setdefault(note.name, []).append(target)
+            else:
+                backlinks[destination].add(note.name)
+
+    return {
+        "notes": len(notes),
+        "links": link_count,
+        "backlinks": {name: sorted(sources) for name, sources in backlinks.items()},
+        "broken": broken,
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Write the report and show broken links and totals.
+
+    Args:
+        argv: Command arguments, or process arguments when None.
+
+    Returns:
+        Exit status: 0 for a folder, or 2 when the folder is invalid.
+    """
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("root", help="the notes folder")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if not os.path.isdir(args.root):
+        logger.warning("%s is not a folder", args.root)
+        return 2
+
+    report = build_backlinks(args.root)
+    destination = os.path.join(args.root, REPORT_FILE)
+    with open(destination, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        json.dump(report, output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+        output.write("\n")
+
+    for note, targets in report["broken"].items():
+        for target in targets:
+            logger.warning("broken link in %s: %s", note, target)
+    broken_count = sum(len(targets) for targets in report["broken"].values())
+    print(f"{report['notes']} notes, {report['links']} links, {broken_count} broken links")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Parse finite decimal numbers without binary floating point."""
+import re
+from fractions import Fraction
+from typing import Any
+
+DECIMAL = re.compile(r"[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?\Z")
+
+
+def parse_number(value: Any) -> Fraction:
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or DECIMAL.fullmatch(text) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"bad number {value!r}")
+    mantissa, separator, exponent = text.lower().partition("e")
+    places = len(mantissa.partition(".")[2]) - (int(exponent) if separator else 0)
+    digits = int(mantissa.replace(".", ""))
+    if places >= 0:
+        return Fraction(digits, 10 ** places)
+    return Fraction(digits * 10 ** -places)

+"""Split trip costs among participants: python -m fuelcost.split."""
+import argparse
+import csv
+import sys
+from fractions import Fraction
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+
+from fuelcost.costs import format_money, trip_cost
+from fuelcost.settings import Settings, load_settings
+from fuelcost.trips import Trip, load_trips
+from fuelcost.vehicles import load_vehicles
+
+HEADER = ("name", "trips", "share")
+
+
+def split_rows(trips: List[Trip], vehicles: Dict[str, Fraction],
+               settings: Settings) -> List[List[str]]:
+    counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
+    shares: Dict[str, int] = {}
+    for trip in trips:
+        cost_cents = trip_cost(trip, vehicles, settings)
+        participants = (trip.driver,) + trip.riders
+        for person in participants:
+            counts[person] = counts.get(person, 0) + 1
+            shares.setdefault(person, 0)
+        payers = participants if settings.driver == "pays" or not trip.riders else trip.riders
+        base, remainder = divmod(cost_cents, len(payers))
+        for payer in payers:
+            shares[payer] += base
+        shares[payers[0]] += remainder
+    return [[person, str(counts[person]), format_money(shares[person])]
+            for person in sorted(counts)]
+
+
+def write_split(rows: List[List[str]], path: str) -> None:
+    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        writer = csv.writer(handle)
+        writer.writerow(HEADER)
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m fuelcost.split")
+    parser.add_argument("trips")
+    parser.add_argument("vehicles")
+    parser.add_argument("output")
+    parser.add_argument("--settings", default=None, metavar="FILE")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        settings = load_settings(args.settings)
+        vehicles = load_vehicles(args.vehicles)
+        trips = load_trips(args.trips)
+        rows = split_rows(trips, vehicles, settings)
+        write_split(rows, args.output)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

 def parseAmount(value: Any, name: str) -> Decimal:
     """Return a money amount from a JSON value; it must not be negative."""
     try:
         amount = Decimal(str(value))
     except InvalidOperation:
         raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a number, got {value!r}") from None
     if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
         raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be negative, got {value!r}")
     return amount
 
 
 def parsePrice(value: Any) -> Decimal:
     """Return the fuel price per litre; it must be above zero."""
     price = parseAmount(value, "price")
     if price == 0:
         raise ValueError("price must be above zero")
     return price
 
 
 def parseWear(value: Any) -> Decimal:
     """Return the wear charge per km."""
     return parseAmount(value, "wear")
 
 
 def parseCurrency(value: Any) -> str:
     """Return the currency code, for example EUR."""
     if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
         raise ValueError(f"currency must be a non-empty text, got {value!r}")

+    """Return whether drivers share the cost when riders are present."""
+    if value not in ("pays", "free") or not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"driver must be 'pays' or 'free', got {value!r}")
+    return value
+
+
 PARSERS: dict[str, Callable[[Any], Any]] = {
     "price": parsePrice,
     "wear": parseWear,
     "currency": parseCurrency,
+    "driver": parseDriver,

 def loadSettings(path: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Return the settings: the defaults, updated with the values of the JSON file at path.
 
     Raises OSError when the file cannot be read and ValueError when it is invalid.
     """
     settings = dict(DEFAULTS)
     if path is None:
         return settings
     with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
         try:
             data = json.load(handle, parse_float=Decimal)
         except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
             raise ValueError(f"{path}: not valid JSON ({exc.msg})") from None
     if not isinstance(data, dict):

+"""Split each trip's cost among its driver and riders."""
+import argparse
+import csv
+import sys
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+from fuelcost.costs import tripCost
+from fuelcost.settings import loadSettings
+from fuelcost.trips import Trip, loadTrips
+from fuelcost.vehicles import loadVehicles
+
+HEADER = ("name", "trips", "share")
+
+
+def splitRows(trips: list[Trip], vehicles: dict[str, Decimal],
+              settings: dict[str, Any]) -> list[list[str]]:
+    """Return one row per participant, sorted by name."""
+    tripCounts: dict[str, int] = {}
+    shares: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for trip in trips:
+        participants = (trip.driver, *trip.riders)
+        for name in participants:
+            tripCounts[name] = tripCounts.get(name, 0) + 1
+            shares.setdefault(name, 0)
+
+        costCents = int(tripCost(trip, vehicles, settings) * 100)
+        payers = participants if settings["driver"] == "pays" or not trip.riders else trip.riders
+        each, remainder = divmod(costCents, len(payers))
+        for name in payers:
+            shares[name] += each
+        shares[payers[0]] += remainder
+
+    return [[name, str(tripCounts[name]), f"{shares[name] // 100}.{shares[name] % 100:02d}"]
+            for name in sorted(tripCounts)]
+
+
+def writeSplit(rows: list[list[str]], path: str) -> None:
+    """Write the split rows as CSV with the header line."""
+    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        writer = csv.writer(handle)
+        writer.writerow(HEADER)
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Write the cost split. Return the exit status."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m fuelcost.split")
+    parser.add_argument("trips")
+    parser.add_argument("vehicles")
+    parser.add_argument("output")
+    parser.add_argument("--settings", default=None, metavar="FILE")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        settings = loadSettings(args.settings)
+        vehicles = loadVehicles(args.vehicles)
+        trips = loadTrips(args.trips)

+"""Check hosts file entries and write a JSON report.
+
+Run as ``python -m hostsfile.lint HOSTS_FILE OUTPUT_JSON``.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .address import address_family, is_valid_name, name_key
+from .model import HostLine, HostsFileError, LineKind
+from .parser import read_hosts
+
+BAD_ADDRESS = "bad_address"
+BAD_NAME = "bad_name"
+DUPLICATE = "duplicate"
+
+
+def check_entries(lines: list[HostLine]) -> dict:
+    """Check parsed entry lines for address, name, and duplicate issues.
+
+    Args:
+        lines: Parsed hosts file lines in file order.
+
+    Returns:
+        A report with the entry count, ordered issues, and counts by kind.
+
+    Raises:
+        HostsFileError: If an entry has no host name; the error gives its line.
+    """
+    issues = []
+    counts = {BAD_ADDRESS: 0, BAD_NAME: 0, DUPLICATE: 0}
+    seen = set()
+    entries = 0
+
+    def add_issue(number: int, kind: str, value: str) -> None:
+        issues.append({"line": number, "kind": kind, "value": value})
+        counts[kind] += 1
+
+    for line in lines:
+        if line.kind is not LineKind.ENTRY:
+            continue
+        entries += 1
+        if not line.names:
+            raise HostsFileError(f"line {line.number}: no host name")
+        try:
+            family = address_family(line.address)
+        except HostsFileError:
+            family = None
+            add_issue(line.number, BAD_ADDRESS, line.address)
+        for name in line.names:
+            if not is_valid_name(name):
+                add_issue(line.number, BAD_NAME, name)
+            elif family is not None:
+                key = (family, name_key(name))
+                if key in seen:
+                    add_issue(line.number, DUPLICATE, name)
+                else:
+                    seen.add(key)
+    return {"entries": entries, "issues": issues, "counts": counts}
+
+
+def lint_hosts(path: Path) -> dict:
+    """Read a hosts file and build its lint report.
+
+    Args:
+        path: The hosts file to read.
+
+    Returns:
+        The report with its bare file name, entry count, issues, and counts.
+
+    Raises:
+        HostsFileError: If the file is missing or an entry has no host name.
+    """
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise HostsFileError(f"hosts file not found: {path}")
+    return {"file": path.name, **check_entries(read_hosts(path))}
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the lint command and write its JSON report.
+
+    Args:
+        argv: Arguments without the program name, or None for sys.argv[1:].
+
+    Returns:
+        Status 0 for no issues, 1 for issues, or 2 for invalid input.
+    """
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m hostsfile.lint")
+    parser.add_argument("hosts_file")
+    parser.add_argument("output_json")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        report = lint_hosts(Path(args.hosts_file))
+    except HostsFileError as err:
+        print(f"error: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    output = Path(args.output_json)
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return 1 if report["issues"] else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Build a shopping list from a weekly recipe plan."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, NamedTuple, Optional, Tuple
+
+from recipebox.models import Ingredient
+from recipebox.parser import load_recipe
+from recipebox.scaling import format_ingredient, round_quantity, scale_recipe
+from recipebox.units import to_base_unit
+
+
+class ShoppingItem(NamedTuple):
+    """A total ingredient amount and the recipes that use it."""
+
+    name: str
+    quantity: float
+    unit: str
+    recipes: List[str]
+
+
+def parsePlanLine(line: str, line_number: int) -> Tuple[str, int]:
+    """Return a recipe filename and positive whole-number servings from a plan line."""
+    fields = line.split()
+    if len(fields) != 2 or not fields[1].isdecimal() or int(fields[1]) < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"plan line {line_number}: expected a recipe file and positive whole-number servings: {line.strip()!r}")
+    return fields[0], int(fields[1])
+
+
+def buildShoppingList(plan_path: Path) -> List[ShoppingItem]:
+    """Scale and combine the ingredients in a plan into sorted shopping items."""
+    totals: Dict[Tuple[str, str], float] = {}
+    recipes: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[str]] = {}
+    for line_number, line in enumerate(plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        file_name, servings = parsePlanLine(line, line_number)
+        recipe_path = plan_path.parent / file_name
+        try:
+            recipe = load_recipe(str(recipe_path))
+        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"plan line {line_number}, recipe {recipe_path}: {exc}") from exc
+        if recipe.servings < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"plan line {line_number}, recipe {recipe_path}: servings must be at least 1")
+        for ingredient in scale_recipe(recipe, servings).ingredients:
+            quantity, unit = to_base_unit(ingredient.quantity, ingredient.unit)
+            key = (ingredient.name.lower(), unit)
+            totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0.0) + quantity
+            titles = recipes.setdefault(key, [])
+            if recipe.title not in titles:
+                titles.append(recipe.title)
+    return [
+        ShoppingItem(name, quantity, unit, recipes[(name, unit)])
+        for (name, unit), quantity in sorted(totals.items())
+    ]
+
+

+"""Build a shopping list from a plan of recipe files and servings."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from recipebox.models import Ingredient
+from recipebox.parser import load_recipe
+from recipebox.scaling import format_ingredient, round_quantity, scale_recipe
+from recipebox.units import to_base_unit
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ShoppingItem:
+    """An accumulated ingredient amount and its recipe titles."""
+
+    name: str
+    quantity: float
+    unit: str
+    recipes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+def build_shopping_list(plan_path: Path) -> dict[str, list]:
+    """Read a plan and return its sorted JSON-ready items and display lines."""
+    try:
+        plan_text = plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"cannot read plan {plan_path}: {error}") from error
+
+    items: dict[tuple[str, str], ShoppingItem] = {}
+    for line_number, line in enumerate(plan_text.splitlines(), start=1):
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        fields = line.split()
+        if len(fields) != 2 or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", fields[1]) is None or int(fields[1]) < 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"invalid plan line {line_number}: expected a recipe file "
+                f"and positive whole-number servings: {line!r}"
+            )
+
+        recipe_path = plan_path.parent / fields[0]
+        try:
+            recipe = load_recipe(str(recipe_path))
+        except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError) as error:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"cannot read or parse recipe {recipe_path} "
+                f"on plan line {line_number}: {error}"
+            ) from error
+        if recipe.servings < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid servings in recipe {recipe_path}: {recipe.servings}")
+
+        scaled = scale_recipe(recipe, int(fields[1]))
+        for ingredient in scaled.ingredients:
+            quantity, unit = to_base_unit(ingredient.quantity, ingredient.unit)
+            name = ingredient.name.lower()
+            key = (name, unit)
+            if key not in items:
+                items[key] = ShoppingItem(name, 0.0, unit)
+            item = items[key]
+            item.quantity += quantity
+            if recipe.title not in item.recipes:
+                item.recipes.append(recipe.title)
+
+    ordered = [items[key] for key in sorted(items)]
+    return {
+        "items": [
+            {
+                "name": item.name,
+                "quantity": round_quantity(item.quantity),
+                "unit": item.unit,
+                "recipes": item.recipes,
+            }
+            for item in ordered
+        ],
+        "lines": [
+            f"{format_ingredient(Ingredient(item.name, item.quantity, item.unit))} ({', '.join(item.recipes)})"
+            for item in ordered
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Write a shopping list for PLAN to OUTPUT and return an exit status."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Write a meal plan shopping list as JSON.")
+    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path, metavar="PLAN")
+    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path, metavar="OUTPUT")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        shopping_list = build_shopping_list(args.plan)
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(shopping_list, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f"shopping: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Split a bill by weights and write the result as JSON.
+
+Run as ``python -m tipjar.shares BILL_CSV SHARES_CSV OUTPUT_JSON [--tip PERCENT]``.
+"""
+import argparse
+import csv
+import json
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from tipjar.bill import BillItem, load_bill, subtotal
+from tipjar.tips import parse_percent
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Share:
+    """A person and their positive share weight."""
+
+    name: str
+    weight: int
+
+
+def load_shares(path: str) -> tuple[Optional[list[Share]], Optional[str]]:
+    """Read people from a CSV file, returning an error with its line number."""
+    try:
+        with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
+            if not {"name", "weight"}.issubset(reader.fieldnames or []):
+                return None, f"{path}:1: expected name,weight header"
+            people: list[Share] = []
+            names: set[str] = set()
+            for row in reader:
+                if None in row or row.get("name") is None or row.get("weight") is None:
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: invalid shares row"
+                name = (row["name"] or "").strip()
+                weight_text = (row["weight"] or "").strip()
+                if not name:
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: empty name"
+                if name in names:
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: duplicate name {name!r}"
+                if not weight_text.isascii() or not weight_text.isdecimal():
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: invalid weight {weight_text!r}"
+                try:
+                    weight = int(weight_text)
+                except ValueError:
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: invalid weight"
+                if weight < 1:
+                    return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num}: invalid weight {weight_text!r}"
+                people.append(Share(name, weight))
+                names.add(name)
+            if not people:
+                return None, f"{path}:{reader.line_num + 1}: the shares file has no people"
+            return people, None
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, csv.Error) as error:
+        return None, f"{path}: {error}"
+
+
+def compute_amounts(
+    items: list[BillItem], people: list[Share], tip_percent: Optional[int] = None
+) -> tuple[Optional[int], int, list[int]]:
+    """Return tip, total and weighted amounts in cents, in file order."""
+    subtotal_cents = int(subtotal(items) * 100)
+    tip_cents = None if tip_percent is None else (subtotal_cents * tip_percent + 50) // 100
+    total_cents = subtotal_cents + (tip_cents or 0)
+    total_weight = sum(person.weight for person in people)
+    if total_weight < 1 or any(person.weight < 1 for person in people):
+        raise ValueError("need people with positive weights")
+    amounts = [total_cents * person.weight // total_weight for person in people]
+    for index in range(total_cents - sum(amounts)):
+        amounts[index] += 1
+    return tip_cents, total_cents, amounts
+
+
+def format_cents(amount: int) -> str:
+    """Write integer cents as money text."""
+    return f"{amount // 100}.{amount % 100:02d}"
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: Optional[list[str]]) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse the shares command line."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m tipjar.shares")
+    parser.add_argument("bill", help="bill CSV file with the header item,amount")
+    parser.add_argument("shares", help="shares CSV file with the header name,weight")
+    parser.add_argument("output", help="JSON file to write")
+    parser.add_argument("--tip", help="tip percentage, such as 15 or 15%%")
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
+    """Write the shares JSON and return the command exit status."""
+    args = parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        items = load_bill(args.bill)
+        people, error = load_shares(args.shares)
+        if error is not None or people is None:
+            sys.stderr.write(f"error: {error or 'invalid shares file'}\n")
+            return 2
+        tip_percent = parse_percent(args.tip)
+        tip_cents, total_cents, amounts = compute_amounts(items, people, tip_percent)
+        result = {
+            "subtotal": format_cents(int(subtotal(items) * 100)),
+            "tip": None if tip_cents is None else format_cents(tip_cents),
+            "total": format_cents(total_cents),
+            "shares": [
+                {"name": person.name, "weight": person.weight, "amount": format_cents(amount)}
+                for person, amount in zip(people, amounts)
+            ],
+        }
+        with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            json.dump(result, handle, ensure_ascii=False)
+            handle.write("\n")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError, csv.Error) as error:
+        sys.stderr.write(f"error: {error}\n")
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Write a JSON bill split weighted by each person's share.
+
+Run as ``python -m tipjar.shares BILL_CSV SHARES_CSV OUTPUT_JSON [--tip PERCENT]``.
+"""
+import argparse
+import csv
+import json
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from .bill import load_bill, subtotal
+from .money import TWO_PLACES, format_amount
+from .tips import parse_percent, tip_amount, total_with_tip
+
+SHARES_COLUMNS = ("name", "weight")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Share:
+    """One person's name and positive, whole-number weight."""
+
+    name: str
+    weight: int
+
+
+def load_shares(path: str) -> list[Share]:
+    """Read a shares CSV, raising ValueError with a line number for bad input."""
+    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
+        missing = [column for column in SHARES_COLUMNS if column not in (reader.fieldnames or [])]
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError("{}:1: missing columns {}".format(path, ", ".join(missing)))
+        people = []
+        names = set()
+        for row in reader:
+            name = (row["name"] or "").strip()
+            weight_text = (row["weight"] or "").strip()
+            if not name:
+                raise ValueError("{}:{}: person without a name".format(path, reader.line_num))
+            if name in names:
+                raise ValueError("{}:{}: duplicate name {!r}".format(path, reader.line_num, name))
+            try:
+                weight = int(weight_text) if weight_text.isascii() and weight_text.isdecimal() else 0
+            except ValueError:
+                weight = 0
+            if weight < 1:
+                raise ValueError("{}:{}: invalid weight {!r}".format(path, reader.line_num, weight_text))
+            people.append(Share(name, weight))
+            names.add(name)
+    if not people:
+        raise ValueError("{}:2: the shares file has no people".format(path))
+    return people
+
+
+def calculate_amounts(sub: Decimal, people: list[Share], percent: int | None) -> tuple[Decimal | None, Decimal, list[Decimal]]:
+    """Compute the tip, total, and weighted amounts in shares-file order."""
+    if not people or any(person.weight < 1 for person in people):
+        raise ValueError("need people with positive weights")
+    tip = tip_amount(sub, percent)
+    total = total_with_tip(sub, tip)
+    total_cents = int(total / TWO_PLACES)
+    total_weight = sum(person.weight for person in people)
+    cents = [total_cents * person.weight // total_weight for person in people]
+    leftover = total_cents - sum(cents)
+    for index in range(leftover):
+        cents[index] += 1
+    return tip, total, [Decimal(amount) * TWO_PLACES for amount in cents]
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse the command line of the shares command."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m tipjar.shares")
+    parser.add_argument("bill", help="bill CSV file with the header item,amount")
+    parser.add_argument("shares", help="shares CSV file with the header name,weight")
+    parser.add_argument("output", help="JSON file to write")
+    parser.add_argument("--tip", help="tip percentage, such as 15 or 15%%")
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the shares command and return its exit status."""
+    args = parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        items = load_bill(args.bill)
+        people = load_shares(args.shares)
+        percent = parse_percent(args.tip)
+        sub = subtotal(items)
+        tip, total, amounts = calculate_amounts(sub, people, percent)
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+        return 2
+    result = {
+        "subtotal": format_amount(sub),
+        "tip": None if tip is None else format_amount(tip),
+        "total": format_amount(total),
+        "shares": [
+            {"name": person.name, "weight": person.weight, "amount": format_amount(amount)}
+            for person, amount in zip(people, amounts)
+        ],
+    }
+    try:
+        with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            json.dump(result, handle)
+            handle.write("\n")
+    except OSError:
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Write a JSON report of conflicts among bookings.
+
+Run as ``python -m roomsched.conflicts ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON``.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+
+from roomsched.bookings import active_bookings, load_bookings
+from roomsched.rooms import load_rooms
+from roomsched.schedule import ranges_overlap
+
+USAGE = "usage: python -m roomsched.conflicts ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON"
+
+
+def build_conflicts(
+    rooms: dict[str, dict], bookings: list[dict]
+) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
+    """Find conflicts in bookings, preserving their file order.
+
+    :param rooms: the rooms keyed by name.
+    :param bookings: all bookings in file order, including cancelled bookings.
+    :returns: ``(report, None)`` with ``conflicts`` and ``counts``, or
+        ``(None, message)`` when any booking names an unknown room.
+    """
+    for booking in bookings:
+        if booking["room"] not in rooms:
+            return None, f"booking {booking['id']}: unknown room {booking['room']!r}"
+
+    conflicts = []
+    counts = {"overlap": 0, "hours": 0, "capacity": 0}
+    earlier_by_room_day: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]] = {}
+    for booking in active_bookings(bookings):
+        key = (booking["room"], booking["date"])
+        for earlier in earlier_by_room_day.get(key, []):
+            if ranges_overlap(
+                earlier["start"], earlier["end"], booking["start"], booking["end"]
+            ):
+                conflicts.append({"booking": booking["id"], "kind": "overlap", "other": earlier["id"]})
+                counts["overlap"] += 1
+
+        room = rooms[booking["room"]]
+        if booking["start"] < room["opens"] or booking["end"] > room["closes"]:
+            conflicts.append({"booking": booking["id"], "kind": "hours", "other": None})
+            counts["hours"] += 1
+        if booking["attendees"] > room["capacity"]:
+            conflicts.append({"booking": booking["id"], "kind": "capacity", "other": None})
+            counts["capacity"] += 1
+
+        earlier_by_room_day.setdefault(key, []).append(booking)
+
+    return {"conflicts": conflicts, "counts": counts}, None
+
+
+def write_conflicts(report: dict, path: str) -> None:
+    """Write a conflict report as JSON.
+
+    :param report: the report returned by ``build_conflicts``.
+    :param path: the JSON file to write.
+    :returns: None.
+    """
+    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        json.dump(report, handle, indent=2)
+        handle.write("\n")
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    """Run the conflicts command.
+
+    :param argv: the arguments ``ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON``.
+    :returns: 0 on success or 2 when the arguments or input are invalid.
+    """
+    if len(argv) != 3:
+        print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    rooms_path, bookings_path, output = argv
+    rooms, error = load_rooms(rooms_path)
+    if not error:
+        bookings, error = load_bookings(bookings_path)
+    if not error:
+        report, error = build_conflicts(rooms, bookings)
+    if error:
+        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    write_conflicts(report, output)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

+"""Report booking conflicts across all rooms and days.
+
+Run as ``python -m roomsched.conflicts ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON``.
+"""
+
+import csv
+from enum import Enum
+import json
+import sys
+
+from roomsched.bookings import load_bookings
+from roomsched.rooms import load_rooms
+from roomsched.schedule import ranges_overlap
+
+
+USAGE = "usage: python -m roomsched.conflicts ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON"
+
+
+class Status(Enum):
+    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
+    TENTATIVE = "tentative"
+    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
+
+
+class ConflictKind(Enum):
+    OVERLAP = "overlap"
+    HOURS = "hours"
+    CAPACITY = "capacity"
+
+
+def findConflicts(rooms: dict[str, dict], bookings: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    """Find conflicts among active bookings in file order.
+
+    Args:
+        rooms: Rooms keyed by name, as returned by ``load_rooms``.
+        bookings: Bookings in file order, as returned by ``load_bookings``.
+
+    Returns:
+        A report with ordered ``conflicts`` entries and a ``counts`` mapping
+        containing every conflict kind.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: An active booking names a room absent from ``rooms``.
+    """
+    conflicts = []
+    counts = {kind.value: 0 for kind in ConflictKind}
+    earlier_by_room_and_day: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]] = {}
+
+    for booking in bookings:
+        if Status(booking["status"]) is Status.CANCELLED:
+            continue
+
+        name = booking["room"]
+        if name not in rooms:
+            raise ValueError(f"booking {booking['id']}: unknown room {name!r}")
+
+        def addConflict(kind: ConflictKind, other: str | None = None) -> None:
+            conflicts.append({"booking": booking["id"], "kind": kind.value, "other": other})
+            counts[kind.value] += 1
+
+        earlier = earlier_by_room_and_day.setdefault((name, booking["date"]), [])
+        for previous in earlier:
+            if ranges_overlap(
+                previous["start"], previous["end"], booking["start"], booking["end"]
+            ):
+                addConflict(ConflictKind.OVERLAP, previous["id"])
+
+        room = rooms[name]
+        if booking["start"] < room["opens"] or booking["end"] > room["closes"]:
+            addConflict(ConflictKind.HOURS)
+        if booking["attendees"] > room["capacity"]:
+            addConflict(ConflictKind.CAPACITY)
+        earlier.append(booking)
+
+    return {"conflicts": conflicts, "counts": counts}
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    """Run the conflict report command.
+
+    Args:
+        argv: ``ROOMS_CSV BOOKINGS_CSV OUTPUT_JSON`` arguments.
+
+    Returns:
+        Exit status 0 on success, or 2 for invalid input or a file error.
+
+    Raises:
+        None. Input and file errors are reported on stderr.
+    """
+    if len(argv) != 3:
+        print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    rooms_path, bookings_path, output_path = argv
+    try:
+        rooms, error = load_rooms(rooms_path)
+        if error:
+            raise ValueError(error)
+        bookings, error = load_bookings(bookings_path)
+        if error:
+            raise ValueError(error)
+        report = findConflicts(rooms, bookings)
+        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            json.dump(report, handle, indent=2)
+            handle.write("\n")
+    except (ValueError, OSError, UnicodeError, csv.Error) as error:
+        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

+"""Find and export long intervals between station readings."""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from statistics import median
+from typing import Optional
+
+from stationlog.readings import Reading, by_station, load_readings
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Gap:
+    """A long interval between consecutive readings of one station."""
+
+    station: str
+    start: datetime
+    end: datetime
+    minutes: int
+
+
+def find_gaps(readings: list[Reading], max_minutes: Optional[int] = None) -> list[Gap]:
+    """Find gaps using a fixed limit or three times each station's median interval."""
+    if max_minutes is not None and (type(max_minutes) is not int or max_minutes <= 0):
+        raise ValueError("max_minutes must be a positive whole number")
+
+    gaps = []
+    for station, station_readings in sorted(by_station(readings).items()):
+        ordered = sorted(station_readings, key=lambda reading: reading.time)
+        intervals = [
+            (later.time - earlier.time).total_seconds() / 60
+            for earlier, later in zip(ordered, ordered[1:])
+        ]
+        if not intervals:
+            continue
+        limit = max_minutes if max_minutes is not None else 3 * median(intervals)
+        for earlier, later, minutes in zip(ordered, ordered[1:], intervals):
+            if minutes > limit:
+                gaps.append(Gap(station, earlier.time, later.time, int(minutes)))
+    return gaps
+
+
+def positive_minutes(value: str) -> int:
+    """Parse a positive whole number for the command line."""
+    try:
+        minutes = int(value)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("N must be a positive whole number") from exc
+    if minutes <= 0:
+        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("N must be a positive whole number")
+    return minutes
+
+
+def write_gaps(gaps: list[Gap], target: Path) -> None:
+    """Write a gap report, including its header when there are no gaps."""
+    with target.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        writer = csv.writer(handle)
+        writer.writerow(("station", "start", "end", "minutes"))
+        for gap in gaps:
+            writer.writerow((
+                gap.station,
+                gap.start.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M"),
+                gap.end.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M"),
+                gap.minutes,
+            ))
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
+    """Create a gap report for one station export and return its exit status."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="stationlog.gaps", description="Station reading gaps.")
+    parser.add_argument("input_csv", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-minutes", type=positive_minutes)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    try:
+        readings = load_readings(args.input_csv)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"error: cannot load {args.input_csv}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    gaps = find_gaps(readings, args.max_minutes)
+    target = args.input_csv.with_suffix(".gaps.csv")
+    write_gaps(gaps, target)
+
+    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for gap in gaps:
+        counts[gap.station] = counts.get(gap.station, 0) + 1
+    for station, count in sorted(counts.items()):
+        if count > 5:
+            print(f"warning: {station} has {count} gaps", file=sys.stderr)
+    print(f"Found {len(gaps)} gaps in {len(counts)} stations.")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Grade filled-in answer sheets against the question banks.
+
+Run as ``python -m quizgen.grade BANKS_DIR SHEETS_DIR OUTPUT_CSV``.
+"""
+import argparse
+import csv
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from quizgen.bank import Question, loadBanks
+
+GRADE_COLUMNS = ("student", "score", "possible", "correct", "wrong", "blank", "unknown")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class GradeResult:
+    """The score and line counts for one student's sheet."""
+
+    student: str
+    score: int
+    possible: int
+    correct: int
+    wrong: int
+    blank: int
+    unknown: int
+
+
+def gradeSheet(student: str, sheet: str, questions: dict[str, Question]) -> GradeResult:
+    """Grade one sheet, counting repeated and unrecognized question ids as unknown."""
+    result = GradeResult(student, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for line in sheet.splitlines():
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        if ":" not in line:
+            result.unknown += 1
+            continue
+        qid, answer = (part.strip() for part in line.split(":", 1))
+        if qid not in questions or qid in seen:
+            result.unknown += 1
+            continue
+        seen.add(qid)
+        question = questions[qid]
+        result.possible += question.points
+        if not answer:
+            result.blank += 1
+        elif answer.upper() == question.answer:
+            result.correct += 1
+            result.score += question.points
+        else:
+            result.wrong += 1
+    return result
+
+
+def gradeSheets(folder: str | Path, questions: dict[str, Question]) -> list[GradeResult]:
+    """Read and grade every .txt file in a folder, sorted by student name."""
+    root = Path(folder)
+    if not root.is_dir():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no such folder: {folder}")
+    paths = sorted(path for path in root.iterdir() if path.is_file() and path.name.endswith(".txt"))
+    if not paths:
+        raise ValueError(f"no .txt sheets in {folder}")
+    return [gradeSheet(path.name[:-4], path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), questions) for path in paths]
+
+
+def writeGrades(results: list[GradeResult], output: str | Path) -> None:
+    """Write the sorted grade results as a CSV file."""
+    path = Path(output)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
+        writer.writerow(GRADE_COLUMNS)
+        writer.writerows((result.student, result.score, result.possible, result.correct,
+                          result.wrong, result.blank, result.unknown) for result in results)
+
+
+def parseArgs(argv: list[str] | None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse the command line of the grade command."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m quizgen.grade")
+    parser.add_argument("banks", help="folder with the *.ini question banks")
+    parser.add_argument("sheets", help="folder with the students' *.txt answer sheets")
+    parser.add_argument("output", help="CSV file for the grade results")
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the grade command and return its exit status."""
+    args = parseArgs(argv)
+    try:
+        questions = loadBanks(args.banks)
+        results = gradeSheets(args.sheets, questions)
+        writeGrades(results, args.output)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+

+"""Plan the days a neighbour needs to water plants during a trip."""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import date, timedelta
+from typing import Dict, List
+
+from plantcare.plants import Plant, load_plants
+from plantcare.settings import load_settings
+
+
+def plan_visits(plants: List[Plant], leave: date, back: date,
+                max_dry_days: int) -> Dict[str, List[dict]]:
+    """Return visits by plant and by day, starting after our pre-trip watering."""
+    plant_entries: List[dict] = []
+    days: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
+    for plant in plants:
+        visits: List[str] = []
+        last_watered = leave - timedelta(days=1)
+        gap = timedelta(days=plant.interval + max_dry_days)
+        while back - last_watered > gap:
+            last_watered += gap
+            day = last_watered.isoformat()
+            visits.append(day)
+            days.setdefault(day, []).append(plant.name)
+        plant_entries.append({"name": plant.name, "visits": visits})
+    day_entries = [{"date": day, "plants": days[day]} for day in sorted(days)]
+    return {"plants": plant_entries, "days": day_entries}
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="plantcare.vacation")
+    parser.add_argument("leave", type=date.fromisoformat, metavar="LEAVE")
+    parser.add_argument("back", type=date.fromisoformat, metavar="BACK")
+    parser.add_argument("output_file", metavar="OUTPUT_FILE")
+    parser.add_argument("--settings", metavar="FILE")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-dry", type=int, metavar="DAYS")
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: List[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        if args.back <= args.leave:
+            raise ValueError("BACK must be after LEAVE")
+        settings = load_settings(args.settings)
+        max_dry_days = (args.max_dry if args.max_dry is not None
+                        else settings["max_dry_days"])
+        if max_dry_days < 0:
+            raise ValueError("max dry days must be 0 or more")
+        plants_file = settings["plants_file"]
+        if not os.path.isfile(plants_file):
+            raise OSError("cannot read plant file: {}".format(plants_file))
+        plants = load_plants(plants_file, settings["default_interval"])
+        plan = plan_visits(plants, args.leave, args.back, max_dry_days)
+        folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.output_file))
+        os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
+        with open(args.output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            json.dump(plan, handle, indent=2)
+            handle.write("\n")
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, OverflowError) as error:
+        print("error: {}".format(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    print("Neighbour needs to come on {} days.".format(len(plan["days"])))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
